candidate_read_audit.continuation_sufficiency_gate: Within each parent rank n<=11, equal candidate values must imply the same set of unlabelled child topologies under all one-leaf attachments.
candidate_read_audit.exact_witness_gate: Report whether each candidate separates the certified R0 n=4 path/star witness.
candidate_read_audit.selection_rule: Select every candidate in the lowest complexity tier that passes both topology separation through n<=12 and one-step continuation sufficiency through n<=11. If only FULL_TREE_CANON passes, report no compact candidate. Minimality is only within this frozen library/tiering.
candidate_read_audit.topology_separation_gate: Within each rank n<=12, equal candidate values must imply equal unlabelled topology canonical form.

gates.authority: Certified R0 result and exact cold replay comparison must pass and preserve G3 graduation/topology firewall.
gates.fiber_nontriviality: The certified n=4 fiber must contain one public/resource base, >1 coarse topology strata, and >1 fine topology substrata.

gates.r0_prefix: Structural tree generator must reproduce certified R0 tree-shape counts through n=7.
gates.relation_valued_grafting: At least one public/resource transition must have more than one intrinsic child topology under leaf attachment.

shape_transition_census.composition_read: For each topology record the set and attachment-vertex multiplicity of child topologies under one-leaf grafting.
shape_transition_census.construction: Starting from the one-vertex tree, generate every unlabelled tree at rank n+1 by attaching one new leaf at every vertex of every rank-n tree and canonical-deduplicating.
shape_transition_census.r0_prefix_gate: Ranks 1..7 must reproduce the certified R0 unlabelled-tree counts exactly before any extension is accepted.
shape_transition_census.realisability_gate: The certified R0 seed and repeated G3 bridge operator must have endpoint headroom for every vertex degree <=11; the one-cross leaf-addition theorem then structurally realizes every generated shape without exact n>4 relation-frontier materialization.
